body:
It's good to know it is possible to accomplish this from Godot!

We should probably ask for permission or at least notify the user that their settings (especially for a separate application) are being modified.
- They might expect Magnet window snapping to work with Godot, because Magnet is running and they haven't explicitly told it to ignore Godot, then be confused when it doesn't work.
- Furthermore, if they see that Magnet has been set to ignore Godot so they re-enable it, they might be further confused when they next boot up their computer and it's been set to ignore _again_.
- I could potentially see users being nervous about Godot modifying other apps' settings without their consent or knowledge. Asking them for permission to take such an action first would (hopefully) help with this.

Could we perhaps also restart Magnet from Godot after the setting change, so that the changes take effect immediately? I don't know how unique my experience is but I tend to leave my computer (and thus background apps like Magnet) running for _very long_ periods of time, only restarting or shutting down when necessary. So, if an app's settings were updated for me but the app itself needed to be restarted for the changes to take effect, I could go weeks without actually seeing the changes.
Closing in favor of less intrusive https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116524
